reader_contract.problem_3s: One unbranded flat-pack carton visibly opens into two competing supply-network architectures.
reader_contract.insight_10s: Product geometry can lower transport cost while tariff exposure, volatility, capacity, and response time change the right network by SKU.
reader_contract.action_30s: Re-test sourcing category by category: cube, landed cost, duty exposure, volatility, viable capacity, and the value of a faster response.

coherence_rationale: A familiar physical object earns broad attention, the hinge makes the hidden network architecture visible, and the caption turns the public case into a compact SKU-level review lens without treating nearshoring as a universal answer.

atoms.source_mechanism: A single physical structure embodies a proposition before the reader reaches the explanatory copy.
atoms.adaptation: Make the flat-pack object's fold physically become the network hinge, so product geometry visibly creates the operating question.

references.anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the cracked MRP stack, AI/forecast layers, serif statement, navy poster composition, source wording, branding, or any claim about planning systems.
references.visual_inspection_note: The saved visual turns a layered-stack proposition into one cracked sculpture. Only the working-metaphor principle is retained; the new object, story, material language, and reading route are different.

atoms.source_mechanism: A normally abstract operating reality becomes convincing when the reader can literally see the changed flow.
atoms.adaptation: Let the carton unfold into the long-haul and regional paths so the contrast is visible before the caption names the decision factors.

references.anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the spaghetti-diagram subject, before/after factory layout, people, red/green route composition, claimed project outcomes, wording, or branding.
references.visual_inspection_note: The saved visual makes an operational pattern visible rather than merely described. The new direction borrows only that show-the-system mechanism.

atoms.source_mechanism: A concise visual earns a save when a familiar tension lands in one reusable practical model.
atoms.adaptation: Give the reader one compact SKU re-test lens in the caption, while the visual makes product design a memorable first input to the model.

references.anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse inventory formulas, calculation layout, colourful formula cards, worked examples, wording, icons, or branding.
references.visual_inspection_note: The saved formula card joins plain-language explanation and a useful reference. The adaptation uses its compact utility principle only; no formula-card composition is retained.

atoms.source_mechanism: A visible operating architecture gives the reader a reason to continue from a familiar label into the actual decision system.
atoms.adaptation: The post stands alone, then naturally opens a future field-guide or Substack follow-up about the SKU inputs behind a network decision rather than using a generic lead magnet.

references.anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the three-layer planning engine, its columns, icon set, wording, palette, system labels, artwork, or branding.
references.visual_inspection_note: The source uses an everyday enterprise label to reveal the hidden architecture underneath it. The adaptation changes the subject and uses one physical object rather than a layer diagram.
